pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with low-contrast, soft pixel gradients at the edges. Geometry is primarily non-angular with rounded vertices on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thick, high-luminance negative space forming a continuous web. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial with a high pixel thickness relative to patch size.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the neck and shoulder, consisting of short, dark-colored bristles standing perpendicular to the dorsal line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, vertically-oriented raised linear ridge of skin or protrusion located at the junction of the posterior neck and the shoulder.
other_distinctive_markers: Tail is visible in an upward-curled posture over the posterior flank, showing dark terminal hair against the light pelage.
